name: step-list
title: Step List
description: A compact progress list for background work: one line per step with a done, current, todo or error mark and a time on the right.
usage:
<StepList aria-label="Build progress">
  <StepListItem state="done" time="0:48">Wrote index.json</StepListItem>
  <StepListItem state="current" time="1:19">Testing requests 3 of 5</StepListItem>
  <StepListItem>Preview and publish</StepListItem>
</StepList>
notes: Use Step List for work the app is doing (a build, a deploy, an AI run). Use Stepper for numbered steps a person follows, such as an install guide.
Each item reads its state to screen readers before the label, and the current one gets aria-current="step".
